lines: What happiness is
It isn't a night of falling stars and a dazzling morning
repeating over and over
It's being able to hold an umbrella over the rain
that falls on someone dear
What do we live for?
You don't need an answer
As long as I can protect, even a little,
the people I miss and the things I need
Without stretching myself or playing humble,
just as I am,
if I could sing this feeling of love
What happiness is
It isn't a night of falling stars and a dazzling morning
repeating over and over
It's being able to hold an umbrella over the rain
that falls on someone dear
It's not the kind of thing you find
by straining your eyes without blinking
So I want you by my side
The one who could live for a dream
The one whose detour turned out to be right
The one who spent themselves for someone else
The one who lived as themselves
I couldn't become any of them
But if you still need me today, that's enough
What happiness is
It isn't a night of falling stars and a dazzling morning
repeating over and over
It's being able to hold an umbrella over the rain
that falls on someone dear
To me, who finds my weakness again and stumbles
But could I really manage that?
In the place I found with my eyes closed
What happiness is
It isn't a night of falling stars and a dazzling morning
repeating over and over
It's being able to hold an umbrella over the rain
that falls on someone dear
And before I know it,
it's me who ends up being protected
Always by my side
I want you there, always
Whether my eyes are open or closed
